name: What is an organisation?
origin: Session 1 · Parsons, Katz & Kahn, Schein, Crozier, Aldrich, Mintzberg

parts.label: Coordination mechanisms
points: Hierarchy, rules, objectives, training, mutual adjustment

apply: Start a case answer by naming what is divided and how it is coordinated
pitfalls: Reducing an organisation to its legal form or its organisation chart
